text: しんに　つよい　トレーナーは　かちかたも　うつくしい　ものだ！

structure.jp: しんに　つよい　トレーナーは
かちかたも　うつくしい　ものだ！
structure.en: has a beautiful way of winning too, that's how it is!

patterns.name: 〜ものだ
patterns.span: うつくしい　ものだ
patterns.explanation: ものだ at the end states how things naturally are, like a general truth. うつくしい　ものだ = 'is beautiful, that's just how it is'.

patterns.name: 〜かた
patterns.explanation: かた stuck onto the stem of a verb means 'the way of doing' it. かちかた = 'the way one wins'.
